components.name: Disabled primary button

narrative.overview:
ChildStream uses a quiet, readable Windows surface around the desktop it controls. The native window, familiar controls and restrained palette support a working desktop rather than competing with it. Session identity and explicit text status carry the hierarchy; color reinforces that information.

This documents the implemented WinForms extension in `src/LauncherWindow.cs` and `src/LauncherApplication.cs`, under the approved direction in `docs/launcher-surface.md` and `PRODUCT.md`. It is a native design system; the HTML/CSS snippets in `.impeccable/design.json` are documentation previews for the design panel and are not product components or an implementation framework.
keyCharacteristics: Native Windows chrome, controls, focus rendering and confirmation dialogs.
Pale slate surround, system window surfaces, dark text and blue primary actions.
A dominant desktop workspace with a compact companion control rail.
Text-labelled states, actionable recovery and explicit synthetic-preview labels.

rules.name: The Session Truth Rule
rules.body: Always name the state in text. A green heading alone cannot communicate which session or host is running.

rules.name: The Native Rendering Rule
rules.body: Keep native text metrics, mnemonics and visible focus behavior. Do not translate a web typography convention into a new native font or decorative heading style.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Keep application containers flat and let the desktop remain the working surface.

dos: **Do** keep the native desktop workspace visually dominant.
**Do** identify the child session and host state in readable text.
**Do** use Segoe UI and preserve Windows focus, mnemonics and system-color overrides.
**Do** show Checking Sunshine distinctly while the first child-session status is pending.
**Do** label synthetic previews and retain their evidence limits.
donts: **Don't** introduce decorative cards, neon game-dashboard styling or a second font into this approved surface.
**Don't** use color as the sole signal for running, errors or unavailable state.
**Don't** replace native high-contrast colors with the normal-mode palette.
**Don't** invent custom radius, shadow, hover, motion or breakpoint tokens absent from the implementation.
**Don't** describe explicit layout scaling or synthetic captures as live streaming or OS DPI validation.
